help:
A bot for working with a knowledge base through Claude Code.

Just write a message — it goes to Claude in the context of the repository.
After the work, the changes are committed and pushed automatically, unless the operator turned this off (AUTO_COMMIT=0): then they stay in the working tree.

You can send any file: photo, document, audio, video, voice message (including
an album of several; up to 20 MB). The caption becomes the request; without a
caption Claude will just look at the file(s). A file is not kept between turns:
send it again for a new analysis. Stickers are not supported.

In a forum group every topic is a separate isolated session;
switch between topics to run parallel discussions.

A request to a busy bot is not rejected but joins the common queue (FIFO,
one run at a time); the reply comes to its own topic. Consecutive messages
of a topic, while it waits, are merged into one request.

/new — start a new session (if the topic has a request in progress or in the queue, it joins the queue after it)
/compact — compact the session (a claude run, takes the queue like a regular request)
/cancel — stop the topic's process and drop all its pending requests from the queue
/queue — show the request queue and the reason for the pause
/stats — session statistics and the topic's position in the queue
/verbose — show token usage in replies
/mode — work mode: without an argument sends the arch/review/pm buttons
(the active one is marked ✓, a tap switches it); text also works — /mode review.
The mode is fixed when a request is queued; it can be changed while no run
is in progress in this topic (work in another topic does not interfere)
/lang — language of the replies: without an argument shows the current one and buttons to pick from; /lang <code> switches it too (per user; takes effect from the next message)
/epic start <slug> | pause | resume | status — epic: a set of openronin tasks with an execution order (in the epic topic); without an argument — buttons for what is possible now
/restart — restart the bot (pick up new code)
